title: Image toolchain step 5: Candidates, review and generation with a fake provider
description:
Build step 5 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9).

`ImageCandidate` model with lanes and batch fields, `image-worker`, `image-batch-check`, prompt plans, rounds, polling, retry, iterate, free checks, alt draft from the brief, review status, `image_review` and `image_review_queue`, the `ReviewRequest` index, the `imageReview` publish gate and `stories next` step, cost recording by lane, provenance on `MediaAsset`, expiry on publish.

Specs: `image-generation.feature`, `image-review.feature`, `image-batch.feature`: a person gets one or four on the standard lane; an agent gets one on the batch lane and asking for four gets `set_needs_person`; a batch line fails while others succeed; a 24-hour expiry fails retryably; "Make it now" moves to standard; `before_publish` blocks publish on an unreviewed picture and `after_the_fact` does not; no path writes `human-verified` for an agent; the constraint is in every plan; apply refused without alt text or credit.

What deploys: Backend model + Lambdas + one index, generation off everywhere.

Fulfils or changes: c101a6 (all but the real provider); e4bdd096 acceptance scenarios; supersedes 7c3f6a's storage notes.

Gherkin specs are required, and every PR merges to develop. Spending is only approved for step 6 (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, Machines on Machines trial; Batch where nobody waits). Style guidance is data, never code.
